purpose: Single registry of the platform capability cores tracked by CAPABILITY-CORES-NOT-WIRED. A core is 'wired' only when a named non-test production consumer imports it. The guard ratchets on this file: a wired core may never silently lose its consumer, and a pending core may never be described as wired without one.
not_this: This registry is NOT about optional feature activation (ml_pest_detection, ml_yield_prediction, ml_field_boundary, aquacrop_salinity). Those are governed separately and share only the word 'capability'. Conflating them would mark this gap closed while these cores remain orphaned.

cores.note: Consumed by list_equipment via ?summary=true. Folded into the existing route, so no domain route was spent. Fail-closed: absent maintenance policy yields not_evaluated, never a fabricated due.

BLOCKER CORRECTED 2026-07-28. The recorded blocker (duplicate implementation vs core/field_twin.assemble_twin) was a misdiagnosis: they are different layers and core/field_twin.py:30 already declares itself DERIVED_VIEW with CanonicalFieldState authoritative. assemble_twin consumes DB rows; this core consumes schema-versioned state products. The real blocker is missing producers: of required=(weather, water, soil), only water has one (api/canonical_water_state.py::resolve_canonical_water_state). No producer emits canonical_soil_state./soil-profile. anywhere in the tree, and no platform module emits wx10/canonical-weather-state/. spectral is available (core.crop_intelligence.build_canonical_spectral_state) but is not required. Wiring today would therefore yield operational_eligible=false permanently, making the ratchet witness an empty state rather than a used capability. Unblocking needs a soil and a weather product producer, not plumbing.
